entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_forward_differences
entries.type: sum_forward_differences {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (f : ℕ → A) (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (f (k + 1) - f k)) = f n - f 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_shifted_differences
entries.type: sum_shifted_differences {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (f : ℕ → A) (m n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (f (m + k + 1) - f (m + k))) = f (m + n) - f m

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.reconstruct_of_increments
entries.type: reconstruct_of_increments {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (f g : ℕ → A) (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ k < n, f (k + 1) = f k + g k) : f n = f 0 + ∑ k ∈ range n, g k

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_shift_one
entries.type: sum_shift_one {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (f : ℕ → A) (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, f (k + 1)) = (∑ k ∈ range n, f k) + f n - f 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_product_differences
entries.type: sum_product_differences {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f g : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, f k * (g (k + 1) - g k)) = f n * g n - f 0 * g 0 - ∑ k ∈ range n, (f (k + 1) - f k) * g (k + 1)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_by_parts
entries.type: sum_by_parts {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f g : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, f k * g k) = f n * (∑ k ∈ range n, g k) - ∑ k ∈ range n, (f (k + 1) - f k) * (∑ j ∈ range (k + 1), g j)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_index_mul_difference
entries.type: sum_index_mul_difference {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (k : R) * (f (k + 1) - f k)) = (n : R) * f n - ∑ k ∈ range n, f (k + 1)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_second_differences
entries.type: sum_second_differences {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (f (k + 2) - 2 * f (k + 1) + f k)) = f (n + 1) - f n - f 1 + f 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.geometric_sum_mul_sub
entries.type: geometric_sum_mul_sub {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r : R) (n : ℕ) : (r - 1) * (∑ k ∈ range n, r ^ k) = r ^ n - 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.geometric_sum
entries.type: geometric_sum {K : Type*} [Field K] (r : K) (n : ℕ) (hr : r ≠ 1) : (∑ k ∈ range n, r ^ k) = (r ^ n - 1) / (r - 1)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.shifted_geometric_sum
entries.type: shifted_geometric_sum {K : Type*} [Field K] (r : K) (m n : ℕ) (hr : r ≠ 1) : (∑ k ∈ range n, r ^ (m + k)) = r ^ m * (r ^ n - 1) / (r - 1)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.weighted_geometric_sum_mul_sq
entries.type: weighted_geometric_sum_mul_sq {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r : R) (n : ℕ) : (r - 1) ^ 2 * (∑ k ∈ range n, (k : R) * r ^ k) = ((n : R) - 1) * r ^ (n + 1) - (n : R) * r ^ n + r

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.weighted_geometric_sum
entries.type: weighted_geometric_sum {K : Type*} [Field K] (r : K) (n : ℕ) (hr : r ≠ 1) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (k : K) * r ^ k) = (((n : K) - 1) * r ^ (n + 1) - (n : K) * r ^ n + r) / (r - 1) ^ 2

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_arithmetic_mul_two
entries.type: sum_arithmetic_mul_two {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a d : R) (n : ℕ) : 2 * (∑ k ∈ range n, (a + (k : R) * d)) = (n : R) * (2 * a + ((n : R) - 1) * d)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_arithmetic
entries.type: sum_arithmetic (a d : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (a + (k : ℝ) * d)) = (n : ℝ) * (2 * a + ((n : ℝ) - 1) * d) / 2

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_odd
entries.type: sum_odd {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (2 * (k : R) + 1)) = (n : R) ^ 2

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_squares_mul_six
entries.type: sum_squares_mul_six {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) : 6 * (∑ k ∈ range n, (k : R) ^ 2) = (n : R) * ((n : R) - 1) * (2 * (n : R) - 1)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_squares
entries.type: sum_squares (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (k : ℝ) ^ 2) = (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) / 6

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.sum_cubes
entries.type: sum_cubes (n : ℕ) : (∑ k ∈ range n, (k : ℝ) ^ 3) = ((n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1) / 2) ^ 2

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.affine_recurrence
entries.type: affine_recurrence {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : ℕ → R) (a b : R) (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ k < n, f (k + 1) = a * f k + b) : f n = a ^ n * f 0 + b * (∑ k ∈ range n, a ^ k)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.affine_recurrence_closed
entries.type: affine_recurrence_closed {K : Type*} [Field K] (f : ℕ → K) (a b : K) (n : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 1) (h : ∀ k < n, f (k + 1) = a * f k + b) : f n = a ^ n * f 0 + b * (a ^ n - 1) / (a - 1)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Algebra.FiniteSums.affine_recurrence_upper_bound
entries.type: affine_recurrence_upper_bound (f : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (h : ∀ k < n, f (k + 1) ≤ a * f k + b) : f n ≤ a ^ n * f 0 + b * (∑ k ∈ range n, a ^ k)

entries.type: abs_sign_bool (b : Bool) : |sign b| = 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.abs_average_le

entries.type: IsBooleanValued.abs_derivative {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : IsBooleanValued f) (i : ι) (x : ι → Bool) : |derivative i f x| = if f x ≠ f (flip i x) then 1 else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.fourierCoeff_singleton_eq
entries.type: fourierCoeff_singleton_eq (i : ι) (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : fourierCoeff f {i} = average fun x => derivative i f x * sign (x i)

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.abs_fourierCoeff_singleton_le
entries.type: IsBooleanValued.abs_fourierCoeff_singleton_le {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : IsBooleanValued f) (i : ι) : |fourierCoeff f {i}| ≤ influence i f

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.sum_abs_fourierCoeff_singleton_le
entries.type: IsBooleanValued.sum_abs_fourierCoeff_singleton_le {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : IsBooleanValued f) : ∑ i, |fourierCoeff f {i}| ≤ totalInfluence f

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.sum_abs_fourierCoeff_singleton_le_degree
entries.type: IsBooleanValued.sum_abs_fourierCoeff_singleton_le_degree {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : IsBooleanValued f) : ∑ i, |fourierCoeff f {i}| ≤ degree f

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_le_sum_abs
entries.type: sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_le_sum_abs (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : ∑ i, fourierCoeff f {i} ≤ ∑ i, |fourierCoeff f {i}|

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.levelOneWeight
entries.type: levelOneWeight (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : ℝ

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.levelOneWeight_nonneg
entries.type: levelOneWeight_nonneg (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : 0 ≤ levelOneWeight f

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.levelOneWeight_eq_sum_card_eq_one
entries.type: levelOneWeight_eq_sum_card_eq_one (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : levelOneWeight f = ∑ S ∈ univ.filter (fun S : Finset ι => S.card = 1), fourierCoeff f S ^ 2

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.levelOneWeight_le_average_sq
entries.type: levelOneWeight_le_average_sq (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : levelOneWeight f ≤ average fun x => f x ^ 2

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.levelOneWeight_le_one
entries.type: IsBooleanValued.levelOneWeight_le_one {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : IsBooleanValued f) : levelOneWeight f ≤ 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.sum_abs_fourierCoeff_singleton_le_sqrt
entries.type: sum_abs_fourierCoeff_singleton_le_sqrt (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : ∑ i, |fourierCoeff f {i}| ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card ι) * Real.sqrt (levelOneWeight f)

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.sum_abs_fourierCoeff_singleton_le_sqrt_card
entries.type: IsBooleanValued.sum_abs_fourierCoeff_singleton_le_sqrt_card {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : IsBooleanValued f) : ∑ i, |fourierCoeff f {i}| ≤ Real.sqrt (Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.fourierCoeff_singleton_eq_influence_of_antitone
entries.type: IsBooleanValued.fourierCoeff_singleton_eq_influence_of_antitone {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : IsBooleanValued f) (hmono : Antitone f) (i : ι) : fourierCoeff f {i} = influence i f

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_eq_totalInfluence_of_antitone
entries.type: IsBooleanValued.sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_eq_totalInfluence_of_antitone {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : IsBooleanValued f) (hmono : Antitone f) : ∑ i, fourierCoeff f {i} = totalInfluence f

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.totalInfluence_eq_sum_card
entries.type: totalInfluence_eq_sum_card (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : totalInfluence f = ∑ i, ((univ.filter fun x : ι → Bool => f x ≠ f (flip i x)).card : ℝ) / 2 ^ Fintype.card ι

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.totalInfluence_fin_eq_sum_card
entries.type: totalInfluence_fin_eq_sum_card {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ) : totalInfluence f = ∑ i, ((univ.filter fun x : Fin n → Bool => f x ≠ f (flip i x)).card : ℝ) / 2 ^ n

entries.type: oddSupport (m : ι →₀ ℕ) : Finset ι

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.card_oddSupport_le

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.oddSupport_eq_support
entries.type: oddSupport_eq_support {m : ι →₀ ℕ} (hm : ∀ i, m i ≤ 1) : oddSupport m = m.support

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.sign_pow_eq_ite
entries.type: sign_pow_eq_ite (b : Bool) (k : ℕ) : sign b ^ k = if Odd k then sign b else 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.prod_sign_pow
entries.type: prod_sign_pow (m : ι →₀ ℕ) (x : ι → Bool) : ∏ i ∈ m.support, sign (x i) ^ m i = character (oddSupport m) x

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.evalSign_eq_sum
entries.type: evalSign_eq_sum (p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ) (x : ι → Bool) : evalSign p x = ∑ m ∈ p.support, p.coeff m * character (oddSupport m) x

entries.type: complement (x : ι → Bool) : ι → Bool

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.complement_complement
entries.type: complement_complement (x : ι → Bool) : complement (complement x) = x

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.complementEquiv
entries.type: complementEquiv : (ι → Bool) ≃ (ι → Bool) where toFun

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.character_complement
entries.type: character_complement (S : Finset ι) (x : ι → Bool) : character S (complement x) = (-1) ^ S.card * character S x

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.ite_one_neg_one_eq_sign_not
entries.type: ite_one_neg_one_eq_sign_not (b : Bool) : (if b then (1 : ℝ) else -1) = sign (!b)

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.eval_ite_one_neg_one_eq
entries.type: eval_ite_one_neg_one_eq (p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ) (x : ι → Bool) : MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => if x i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) p = evalSign p (complement x)

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.fourierCoeff_evalSign
entries.type: fourierCoeff_evalSign (p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ) (S : Finset ι) : fourierCoeff (evalSign p) S = ∑ m ∈ p.support with oddSupport m = S, p.coeff m

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.degree_evalSign_le
entries.type: degree_evalSign_le (p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ) : degree (evalSign p) ≤ p.totalDegree

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.fourierCoeff_evalSign_support
entries.type: fourierCoeff_evalSign_support {p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ} (hp : ∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i, m i ≤ 1) {m : ι →₀ ℕ} (hm : m ∈ p.support) : fourierCoeff (evalSign p) m.support = p.coeff m

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.degree_evalSign_of_multilinear
entries.type: degree_evalSign_of_multilinear {p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ} (hp : ∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i, m i ≤ 1) : degree (evalSign p) = p.totalDegree

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.fourierCoeff_comp_complement
entries.type: fourierCoeff_comp_complement (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) : fourierCoeff (fun x => f (complement x)) S = (-1) ^ S.card * fourierCoeff f S

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.degree_comp_complement
entries.type: degree_comp_complement (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : degree (fun x => f (complement x)) = degree f

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.degree_eval_ite_one_neg_one_le
entries.type: degree_eval_ite_one_neg_one_le (p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ) : degree (fun x : ι → Bool => MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => if x i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) p) ≤ p.totalDegree

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.tensor

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.tensor_apply
entries.type: tensor_apply (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (g : (κ → Bool) → ℝ) (x : ι ⊕ κ → Bool) : tensor f g x = f (leftPart x) * g (rightPart x)

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.exists_card_eq_degree

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.degree_tensor
entries.type: degree_tensor {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} {g : (κ → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : degree (tensor f g) = degree f + degree g

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.fourierCoeff_tensor_inl
entries.type: fourierCoeff_tensor_inl (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (g : (κ → Bool) → ℝ) (i : ι) : fourierCoeff (tensor f g) {Sum.inl i} = fourierCoeff f {i} * average g

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.fourierCoeff_tensor_inr
entries.type: fourierCoeff_tensor_inr (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (g : (κ → Bool) → ℝ) (k : κ) : fourierCoeff (tensor f g) {Sum.inr k} = average f * fourierCoeff g {k}

entries.type: sum_fourierCoeff_tensor_singleton (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (g : (κ → Bool) → ℝ) : ∑ u, fourierCoeff (tensor f g) {u} = (∑ i, fourierCoeff f {i}) * average g + average f * ∑ k, fourierCoeff g {k}

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.sum_abs_fourierCoeff_tensor_singleton
entries.type: sum_abs_fourierCoeff_tensor_singleton (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (g : (κ → Bool) → ℝ) : ∑ u, |fourierCoeff (tensor f g) {u}| = (∑ i, |fourierCoeff f {i}|) * |average g| + |average f| * ∑ k, |fourierCoeff g {k}|

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.influence_tensor_inl
entries.type: influence_tensor_inl (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) {g : (κ → Bool) → ℝ} (hg : ∀ y, g y ≠ 0) (i : ι) : influence (Sum.inl i) (tensor f g) = influence i f

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.influence_tensor_inr
entries.type: influence_tensor_inr {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ y, f y ≠ 0) (g : (κ → Bool) → ℝ) (k : κ) : influence (Sum.inr k) (tensor f g) = influence k g

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.totalInfluence_tensor
entries.type: totalInfluence_tensor {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} {g : (κ → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ y, f y ≠ 0) (hg : ∀ y, g y ≠ 0) : totalInfluence (tensor f g) = totalInfluence f + totalInfluence g

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.totalInfluence_tensor
entries.type: IsBooleanValued.totalInfluence_tensor {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} {g : (κ → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : IsBooleanValued f) (hg : IsBooleanValued g) : totalInfluence (BooleanCube.tensor f g) = totalInfluence f + totalInfluence g

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.degree_tensor

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.tensorFin_apply
entries.type: tensorFin_apply (f : (Fin m → Bool) → ℝ) (g : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ) (x : Fin (m + n) → Bool) : tensorFin f g x = f (fun i => x (Fin.castAdd n i)) * g (fun k => x (Fin.natAdd m k))

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.tensorFin

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.degree_tensorFin
entries.type: degree_tensorFin {f : (Fin m → Bool) → ℝ} {g : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) : degree (tensorFin f g) = degree f + degree g

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.totalInfluence_tensorFin
entries.type: totalInfluence_tensorFin {f : (Fin m → Bool) → ℝ} {g : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ y, f y ≠ 0) (hg : ∀ y, g y ≠ 0) : totalInfluence (tensorFin f g) = totalInfluence f + totalInfluence g

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.sum_fourierCoeff_tensorFin_singleton
entries.type: sum_fourierCoeff_tensorFin_singleton (f : (Fin m → Bool) → ℝ) (g : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ) : ∑ i, fourierCoeff (tensorFin f g) {i} = (∑ i, fourierCoeff f {i}) * average g + average f * ∑ k, fourierCoeff g {k}

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.sum_abs_fourierCoeff_tensorFin_singleton
entries.type: sum_abs_fourierCoeff_tensorFin_singleton (f : (Fin m → Bool) → ℝ) (g : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ) : ∑ i, |fourierCoeff (tensorFin f g) {i}| = (∑ i, |fourierCoeff f {i}|) * |average g| + |average f| * ∑ k, |fourierCoeff g {k}|

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.cubeMap_symm_apply
entries.type: cubeMap_symm_apply (e : ι ≃ κ) (y : κ → Bool) (i : ι) : (cubeMap e).symm y i = y (e i)

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.relabel_symm_relabel
entries.type: relabel_symm_relabel {β : Type*} (e : ι ≃ κ) (f : (κ → Bool) → β) : relabel e.symm (relabel e f) = f

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.IsBooleanValued.relabel

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.cubeMap_symm_cubeMap
entries.type: cubeMap_symm_cubeMap (e : ι ≃ κ) (x : ι → Bool) : cubeMap e.symm (cubeMap e x) = x

entries.type: cubeMap_flip (e : ι ≃ κ) (i : ι) (x : ι → Bool) : cubeMap e (flip i x) = flip (e i) (cubeMap e x)

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.cubeMap_flipSet

entries.name: TheoremOS.BooleanCube.Query.certificateComplexityAt_relabel

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.sum_pauli_apply_mul
entries.type: sum_pauli_apply_mul (i j k l : Fin 2) : ∑ a, pauli a i j * pauli a k l = if i = l ∧ j = k then 2 else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.eq_sum_trace_smul_of_completeness
entries.type: eq_sum_trace_smul_of_completeness {n α K : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype α] [Field K] (B : α → Matrix n n K) {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hB : ∀ i j k l, ∑ a, B a i j * B a k l = if i = l ∧ j = k then c else 0) (A : Matrix n n K) : A = c⁻¹ • ∑ a, (B a * A).trace • B a

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauli_expansion
entries.type: pauli_expansion (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : A = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ a, (pauli a * A).trace • pauli a

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauliSign
entries.type: pauliSign (a b : Fin 4) : ℂ

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauli_mul_comm
entries.type: pauli_mul_comm (a b : Fin 4) : pauli a * pauli b = pauliSign a b • (pauli b * pauli a)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauliString
entries.type: pauliString (s : ι → Fin 4) : Matrix (ι → Fin 2) (ι → Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauliString_apply
entries.type: pauliString_apply (s : ι → Fin 4) (x y : ι → Fin 2) : pauliString s x y = ∏ i, pauli (s i) (x i) (y i)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.isHermitian_pauliString
entries.type: isHermitian_pauliString (s : ι → Fin 4) : (pauliString s).IsHermitian

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauliString_zero
entries.type: pauliString_zero : pauliString (0 : ι → Fin 4) = 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauliString_mul_self
entries.type: pauliString_mul_self (s : ι → Fin 4) : pauliString s * pauliString s = 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauliString_mem_unitaryGroup
entries.type: pauliString_mem_unitaryGroup (s : ι → Fin 4) : pauliString s ∈ unitaryGroup (ι → Fin 2) ℂ

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.trace_pauliString_mul
entries.type: trace_pauliString_mul (s t : ι → Fin 4) : (pauliString s * pauliString t).trace = if s = t then 2 ^ Fintype.card ι else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.trace_pauliString
entries.type: trace_pauliString (s : ι → Fin 4) : (pauliString s).trace = if s = 0 then 2 ^ Fintype.card ι else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.sum_pauliString_apply_mul
entries.type: sum_pauliString_apply_mul (x y z w : ι → Fin 2) : ∑ s : ι → Fin 4, pauliString s x y * pauliString s z w = if x = w ∧ y = z then 2 ^ Fintype.card ι else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauliString_expansion
entries.type: pauliString_expansion (A : Matrix (ι → Fin 2) (ι → Fin 2) ℂ) : A = ((2 : ℂ) ^ Fintype.card ι)⁻¹ • ∑ s, (pauliString s * A).trace • pauliString s

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.linearIndependent_pauliString
entries.type: linearIndependent_pauliString : LinearIndependent ℂ (pauliString (ι := ι))

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauliString_mul_comm
entries.type: pauliString_mul_comm (s t : ι → Fin 4) : pauliString s * pauliString t = (∏ i, pauliSign (s i) (t i)) • (pauliString t * pauliString s)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.prod_pauliSign
entries.type: prod_pauliSign (s t : ι → Fin 4) : ∏ i, pauliSign (s i) (t i) = (-1) ^ (univ.filter fun i => s i ≠ 0 ∧ t i ≠ 0 ∧ s i ≠ t i).card

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.pauliString_commute_or_anticommute
entries.type: pauliString_commute_or_anticommute (s t : ι → Fin 4) : pauliString s * pauliString t = pauliString t * pauliString s ∨ pauliString s * pauliString t = -(pauliString t * pauliString s)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor
entries.type: piTensor (a : ι → Matrix m n R) : Matrix (ι → m) (ι → n) R

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_apply
entries.type: piTensor_apply (a : ι → Matrix m n R) (x : ι → m) (y : ι → n) : piTensor a x y = ∏ i, a i (x i) (y i)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_transpose
entries.type: piTensor_transpose (a : ι → Matrix m n R) : (piTensor a)ᵀ = piTensor fun i => (a i)ᵀ

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_smul
entries.type: piTensor_smul (c : ι → R) (a : ι → Matrix m n R) : piTensor (fun i => c i • a i) = (∏ i, c i) • piTensor a

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_eq_zero_of_eq_zero
entries.type: piTensor_eq_zero_of_eq_zero {a : ι → Matrix m n R} {i : ι} (h : a i = 0) : piTensor a = 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_mul
entries.type: piTensor_mul [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype n] (a : ι → Matrix m n R) (b : ι → Matrix n p R) : piTensor a * piTensor b = piTensor fun i => a i * b i

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_one
entries.type: piTensor_one [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq m] : piTensor (fun _ : ι => (1 : Matrix m m R)) = 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.trace_piTensor
entries.type: trace_piTensor [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype m] (a : ι → Matrix m m R) : (piTensor a).trace = ∏ i, (a i).trace

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_mulVec
entries.type: piTensor_mulVec [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype n] (a : ι → Matrix m n R) (v : ι → n → R) : piTensor a *ᵥ (fun y => ∏ i, v i (y i)) = fun x => ∏ i, (a i *ᵥ v i) (x i)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.dotProduct_prod
entries.type: dotProduct_prod [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype n] (v w : ι → n → R) : (fun x : ι → n => ∏ i, v i (x i)) ⬝ᵥ (fun x => ∏ i, w i (x i)) = ∏ i, v i ⬝ᵥ w i

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_sum
entries.type: piTensor_sum [Fintype κ] (a : ι ⊕ κ → Matrix m n R) : piTensor a = (piTensor (fun i => a (Sum.inl i)) ⊗ₖ piTensor (fun k => a (Sum.inr k))).submatrix (Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow ι κ m) (Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow ι κ n)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_fin_succ
entries.type: piTensor_fin_succ {N : ℕ} (a : Fin (N + 1) → Matrix m n R) (x : Fin (N + 1) → m) (y : Fin (N + 1) → n) : piTensor a x y = a 0 (x 0) (y 0) * piTensor (fun i : Fin N => a i.succ) (fun i => x i.succ) (fun i => y i.succ)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_comp_equiv
entries.type: piTensor_comp_equiv [Fintype κ] (e : κ ≃ ι) (a : ι → Matrix m n R) : piTensor (a ∘ e) = (piTensor a).submatrix (fun x => x ∘ e.symm) (fun y => y ∘ e.symm)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_conjTranspose
entries.type: piTensor_conjTranspose (a : ι → Matrix m n R) : (piTensor a)ᴴ = piTensor fun i => (a i)ᴴ

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.isHermitian_piTensor
entries.type: isHermitian_piTensor {a : ι → Matrix m m R} (ha : ∀ i, (a i).IsHermitian) : (piTensor a).IsHermitian

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.piTensor_mem_unitaryGroup
entries.type: piTensor_mem_unitaryGroup [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] {a : ι → Matrix m m R} (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ unitaryGroup m R) : piTensor a ∈ unitaryGroup (ι → m) R

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.posSemidef_piTensor
entries.type: posSemidef_piTensor [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] {a : ι → Matrix m m 𝕜} (ha : ∀ i, (a i).PosSemidef) : (piTensor a).PosSemidef

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.siteOp
entries.type: siteOp (q : ι) (u : Matrix m m R) : Matrix (ι → m) (ι → m) R

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.siteOp_apply
entries.type: siteOp_apply (q : ι) (u : Matrix m m R) (x y : ι → m) : siteOp q u x y = u (x q) (y q) * if ∀ i, i ≠ q → x i = y i then 1 else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.siteOp_one
entries.type: siteOp_one (q : ι) : siteOp q (1 : Matrix m m R) = 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.siteOp_mul_siteOp
entries.type: siteOp_mul_siteOp [Fintype m] (q : ι) (u v : Matrix m m R) : siteOp q u * siteOp q v = siteOp q (u * v)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.siteOp_commute
entries.type: siteOp_commute [Fintype m] {q r : ι} (hqr : q ≠ r) (u v : Matrix m m R) : siteOp q u * siteOp r v = siteOp r v * siteOp q u

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.siteOp_conjTranspose
entries.type: siteOp_conjTranspose [StarRing R] (q : ι) (u : Matrix m m R) : (siteOp q u)ᴴ = siteOp q uᴴ

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.siteOp_mem_unitaryGroup
entries.type: siteOp_mem_unitaryGroup (q : ι) {u : Matrix m m R} (hu : u ∈ unitaryGroup m R) : siteOp q u ∈ unitaryGroup (ι → m) R

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.permOp

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.permOp_apply
entries.type: permOp_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm m) (x y : m) : (permOp σ : Matrix m m R) x y = if x = σ y then 1 else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.permOp_one
entries.type: permOp_one : (permOp 1 : Matrix m m R) = 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.permOp_toPerm
entries.type: permOp_toPerm {f : m → m} (hf : Function.Involutive f) : (permOp (hf.toPerm f) : Matrix m m R) = fun x y => if x = f y then 1 else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.permOp_mul
entries.type: permOp_mul (σ τ : Equiv.Perm m) : (permOp σ * permOp τ : Matrix m m R) = permOp (σ * τ)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.mulVec_permOp
entries.type: mulVec_permOp (σ : Equiv.Perm m) (v : m → R) : (permOp σ : Matrix m m R) *ᵥ v = fun x => v (σ.symm x)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.permOp_conjTranspose
entries.type: permOp_conjTranspose [StarRing R] (σ : Equiv.Perm m) : (permOp σ : Matrix m m R)ᴴ = permOp σ⁻¹

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.permOp_mem_unitaryGroup
entries.type: permOp_mem_unitaryGroup (σ : Equiv.Perm m) : (permOp σ : Matrix m m R) ∈ unitaryGroup m R

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.trace_cfc_eq_sum
entries.type: trace_cfc_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : trace (cfc f A) = ∑ i, (f (hA.eigenvalues i) : 𝕜)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.re_trace_cfc_eq_sum
entries.type: re_trace_cfc_eq_sum {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : RCLike.re (trace (cfc f A)) = ∑ i, f (hA.eigenvalues i)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.vonNeumannEntropy

entries.type: vonNeumannEntropy_def (ρ : Matrix n n 𝕜) : vonNeumannEntropy ρ = RCLike.re (trace (cfc negMulLog ρ))

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.vonNeumannEntropy_eq_entropy
entries.type: vonNeumannEntropy_eq_entropy {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) : vonNeumannEntropy A = entropy hA.eigenvalues

entries.type: vonNeumannEntropy_algebraMap (r : ℝ) : vonNeumannEntropy (algebraMap ℝ (Matrix n n 𝕜) r) = Fintype.card n * negMulLog r

entries.type: isDistribution_eigenvalues (h : IsDensity ρ) : IsDistribution h.isHermitian.eigenvalues where nonneg

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.IsDensity.vonNeumannEntropy_eq_entropy
entries.type: vonNeumannEntropy_eq_entropy (h : IsDensity ρ) : vonNeumannEntropy ρ = entropy h.isHermitian.eigenvalues

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.IsDensity.vonNeumannEntropy_nonneg
entries.type: vonNeumannEntropy_nonneg (h : IsDensity ρ) : 0 ≤ vonNeumannEntropy ρ

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.vonNeumannEntropy_maximallyMixed
entries.type: vonNeumannEntropy_maximallyMixed [Nonempty n] : vonNeumannEntropy (maximallyMixed n 𝕜) = log (Fintype.card n)

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.vonNeumannEntropy_unitary_conj
entries.type: vonNeumannEntropy_unitary_conj {A : Matrix n n 𝕜} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (U : unitary (Matrix n n 𝕜)) : vonNeumannEntropy ((U : Matrix n n 𝕜) * A * star (U : Matrix n n 𝕜)) = vonNeumannEntropy A

entries.name: TheoremOS.LinearAlgebra.vonNeumannEntropy_sum_smul_sub_le
entries.type: vonNeumannEntropy_sum_smul_sub_le (hw : IsDistribution w) (hρ : ∀ a, IsDensity (ρ a)) : vonNeumannEntropy (∑ a, (w a : 𝕜) • ρ a) - ∑ a, w a * vonNeumannEntropy (ρ a) ≤ log (Fintype.card n)

entries.type: neg_log_card_le_vonNeumannEntropy_sum_smul_sub (hw : IsDistribution w) (hρ : ∀ a, IsDensity (ρ a)) : -log (Fintype.card n) ≤ vonNeumannEntropy (∑ a, (w a : 𝕜) • ρ a) - ∑ a, w a * vonNeumannEntropy (ρ a)

entries.type: nat_crt_compatible_iff (m n a b : ℕ) : (∃ x : ℕ, Nat.ModEq m x a ∧ Nat.ModEq n x b) ↔ Nat.ModEq (Nat.gcd m n) a b

entries.name: TheoremOS.NumberTheory.Congruences.nat_crt_existsUnique

entries.name: TheoremOS.NumberTheory.Congruences.nat_crt_family_existsUnique
entries.type: nat_crt_family_existsUnique {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (moduli residues : ι → ℕ) (hpos : ∀ i ∈ I, 0 < moduli i) (hcop : Set.Pairwise (↑I) (fun i j => Nat.Coprime (moduli i) (moduli j))) : ∃! x : ℕ, x < ∏ i ∈ I, moduli i ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, Nat.ModEq (moduli i) x (residues i)

entries.name: TheoremOS.NumberTheory.Congruences.nat_crt_family_solution_iff
entries.type: nat_crt_family_solution_iff {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (moduli residues : ι → ℕ) (hcop : Set.Pairwise (↑I) (fun i j => Nat.Coprime (moduli i) (moduli j))) {x : ℕ} (hx : ∀ i ∈ I, Nat.ModEq (moduli i) x (residues i)) (y : ℕ) : (∀ i ∈ I, Nat.ModEq (moduli i) y (residues i)) ↔ Nat.ModEq (∏ i ∈ I, moduli i) y x

entries.name: TheoremOS.NumberTheory.Congruences.int_modEq_prod_iff

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.biasedMass
entries.type: biasedMass (p : ℝ) (s : Finset α) : ℝ

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.biasedMass_eq_prod_mul_prod
entries.type: biasedMass_eq_prod_mul_prod (p : ℝ) (s : Finset α) : biasedMass p s = (∏ _x ∈ s, p) * ∏ _x ∈ sᶜ, (1 - p)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.biasedMass_eq_pow_mul_pow
entries.type: biasedMass_eq_pow_mul_pow (p : ℝ) (s : Finset α) : biasedMass p s = p ^ s.card * (1 - p) ^ (univ \ s).card

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.biasedMass_compl
entries.type: biasedMass_compl (p : ℝ) (s : Finset α) : biasedMass p sᶜ = biasedMass (1 - p) s

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.biasedMass_nonneg
entries.type: biasedMass_nonneg (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) (s : Finset α) : 0 ≤ biasedMass p s

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_mul_prod_mul_prod
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_mul_prod_mul_prod (p : ℝ) (f g : α → ℝ) : ∑ s, biasedMass p s * ((∏ x ∈ s, f x) * ∏ x ∈ sᶜ, g x) = ∏ x, (p * f x + (1 - p) * g x)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass
entries.type: sum_biasedMass (p : ℝ) : ∑ s : Finset α, biasedMass p s = 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.isDistribution_biasedMass
entries.type: isDistribution_biasedMass (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) : IsDistribution (biasedMass (α := α) p)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_superset
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_superset (p : ℝ) (t : Finset α) : ∑ s with t ⊆ s, biasedMass p s = p ^ t.card

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_mem
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_mem (p : ℝ) (a : α) : ∑ s with a ∈ s, biasedMass p s = p

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_disjoint
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_disjoint (p : ℝ) (t : Finset α) : ∑ s with Disjoint s t, biasedMass p s = (1 - p) ^ t.card

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_mul_card
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_mul_card (p : ℝ) : ∑ s : Finset α, biasedMass p s * s.card = p * Fintype.card α

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_le_of_covers
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_le_of_covers {p : ℝ} (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) {A G : Finset (Finset α)} (hcov : ∀ s ∈ A, ∃ I ∈ G, I ⊆ s) : ∑ s ∈ A, biasedMass p s ≤ ∑ I ∈ G, p ^ I.card

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.biasedMass_zero
entries.type: biasedMass_zero (s : Finset α) : biasedMass 0 s = if s = ∅ then 1 else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.biasedMass_one
entries.type: biasedMass_one (s : Finset α) : biasedMass 1 s = if s = univ then 1 else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.continuous_biasedMass
entries.type: continuous_biasedMass (s : Finset α) : Continuous fun p => biasedMass p s

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.biasedMass_mul_le
entries.type: biasedMass_mul_le (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq₁ : q ≤ 1) (s t : Finset α) : biasedMass p s * biasedMass q t ≤ biasedMass p (s ∩ t) * biasedMass q (s ∪ t)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_mul_le_of_monotone
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_mul_le_of_monotone (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq₁ : q ≤ 1) {F : Finset α → ℝ} (hF : Monotone F) : ∑ s, biasedMass p s * F s ≤ ∑ s, biasedMass q s * F s

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_le_of_isUpperSet
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_le_of_isUpperSet (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq₁ : q ≤ 1) {A : Finset (Finset α)} (hA : ∀ s ∈ A, ∀ t, s ⊆ t → t ∈ A) : ∑ s ∈ A, biasedMass p s ≤ ∑ s ∈ A, biasedMass q s

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.harris
entries.type: harris {p : ℝ} (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) {F G : Finset α → ℝ} (hF : Monotone F) (hG : Monotone G) : (∑ s, biasedMass p s * F s) * (∑ s, biasedMass p s * G s) ≤ ∑ s, biasedMass p s * (F s * G s)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_mul_le_inter
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_mul_le_inter {p : ℝ} (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) {A B : Finset (Finset α)} (hA : ∀ s ∈ A, ∀ t, s ⊆ t → t ∈ A) (hB : ∀ s ∈ B, ∀ t, s ⊆ t → t ∈ B) : (∑ s ∈ A, biasedMass p s) * (∑ s ∈ B, biasedMass p s) ≤ ∑ s ∈ A ∩ B, biasedMass p s

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_eq_sum_powerset_erase
entries.type: sum_eq_sum_powerset_erase {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (x : α) (G : Finset α → M) : ∑ s, G s = ∑ t ∈ (univ.erase x).powerset, (G t + G (insert x t))

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.biasedMass_eq_mul_prod_erase
entries.type: biasedMass_eq_mul_prod_erase (p : ℝ) (x : α) (s : Finset α) : biasedMass p s = (if x ∈ s then p else 1 - p) * ∏ y ∈ univ.erase x, if y ∈ s then p else 1 - p

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.prod_erase_ite_insert
entries.type: prod_erase_ite_insert {s : Finset α} (p : ℝ) (x : α) (t : Finset α) : ∏ y ∈ s.erase x, (if y ∈ insert x t then p else 1 - p) = ∏ y ∈ s.erase x, if y ∈ t then p else 1 - p

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_ite_mul_prod_erase_mul
entries.type: sum_ite_mul_prod_erase_mul (p : ℝ) (x : α) (F : Finset α → ℝ) : ∑ s, (if x ∈ s then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (∏ y ∈ univ.erase x, if y ∈ s then p else 1 - p) * F s = ∑ s, biasedMass p s * (F (insert x s) - F (s.erase x))

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.hasDerivAt_sum_biasedMass_mul
entries.type: hasDerivAt_sum_biasedMass_mul (p : ℝ) (F : Finset α → ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun q => ∑ s, biasedMass q s * F s) (∑ x, ∑ s, biasedMass p s * (F (insert x s) - F (s.erase x))) p

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.hasDerivAt_sum_biasedMass_of_isUpperSet
entries.type: hasDerivAt_sum_biasedMass_of_isUpperSet (p : ℝ) {A : Finset (Finset α)} (hA : ∀ s ∈ A, ∀ t, s ⊆ t → t ∈ A) : HasDerivAt (fun q => ∑ s ∈ A, biasedMass q s) (∑ x, ∑ s with insert x s ∈ A ∧ s.erase x ∉ A, biasedMass p s) p

entries.type: sum_biasedWeight_mul (p : ℝ) (F : (α → Bool) → ℝ) : ∑ x, biasedWeight p x * F x = ∑ s, biasedMass p s * F (configOf s)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedWeight

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.biasedWeight_nonneg

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.continuous_biasedWeight
entries.type: continuous_biasedWeight (x : α → Bool) : Continuous fun p => biasedWeight p x

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.configOf_le_configOf
entries.type: configOf_le_configOf {s t : Finset α} : configOf s ≤ configOf t ↔ s ⊆ t

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.monotone_configOf
entries.type: monotone_configOf : Monotone (configOf (α := α))

entries.type: configOf_erase (s : Finset α) (e : α) : configOf (s.erase e) = Function.update (configOf s) e false

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.monotone_indicator_of_increasing
entries.type: monotone_indicator_of_increasing {f : (α → Bool) → Bool} (hf : ∀ x y, (∀ e, x e = true → y e = true) → f x = true → f y = true) : Monotone fun s : Finset α => if f (configOf s) = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedWeight_mul_le_of_monotone
entries.type: sum_biasedWeight_mul_le_of_monotone (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq₁ : q ≤ 1) {F : (α → Bool) → ℝ} (hF : Monotone F) : ∑ x, biasedWeight p x * F x ≤ ∑ x, biasedWeight q x * F x

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedWeight_ite_le_of_increasing
entries.type: sum_biasedWeight_ite_le_of_increasing (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq₁ : q ≤ 1) {f : (α → Bool) → Bool} (hf : ∀ x y, (∀ e, x e = true → y e = true) → f x = true → f y = true) : ∑ x, biasedWeight p x * (if f x = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ ∑ x, biasedWeight q x * (if f x = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.harris_config
entries.type: harris_config (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) {F G : (α → Bool) → ℝ} (hF : Monotone F) (hG : Monotone G) : (∑ x, biasedWeight p x * F x) * (∑ x, biasedWeight p x * G x) ≤ ∑ x, biasedWeight p x * (F x * G x)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.harris_increasing
entries.type: harris_increasing (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) {f g : (α → Bool) → Bool} (hf : ∀ x y, (∀ e, x e = true → y e = true) → f x = true → f y = true) (hg : ∀ x y, (∀ e, x e = true → y e = true) → g x = true → g y = true) : (∑ x, biasedWeight p x * (if f x = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * (∑ x, biasedWeight p x * (if g x = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ≤ ∑ x, biasedWeight p x * (if f x = true ∧ g x = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.continuous_sum_biasedWeight_mul
entries.type: continuous_sum_biasedWeight_mul (F : (α → Bool) → ℝ) : Continuous fun p => ∑ x, biasedWeight p x * F x

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.hasDerivAt_sum_biasedWeight_mul
entries.type: hasDerivAt_sum_biasedWeight_mul (p : ℝ) (F : (α → Bool) → ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun q => ∑ x, biasedWeight q x * F x) (∑ e, ∑ x, biasedWeight p x * (F (Function.update x e true) - F (Function.update x e false))) p

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.hasDerivAt_sum_biasedWeight_ite_of_increasing
entries.type: hasDerivAt_sum_biasedWeight_ite_of_increasing (p : ℝ) {f : (α → Bool) → Bool} (hf : ∀ x y, (∀ e, x e = true → y e = true) → f x = true → f y = true) : HasDerivAt (fun q => ∑ x, biasedWeight q x * (if f x = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) (∑ e, ∑ x, biasedWeight p x * (if f (Function.update x e true) = true ∧ f (Function.update x e false) = false then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) p

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_filter_le_exp_mul_sum
entries.type: sum_filter_le_exp_mul_sum (w Y : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (c : ℝ) : ∑ i with c ≤ Y i, w i ≤ exp (-(t * c)) * ∑ i, w i * exp (t * Y i)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_filter_le_of_subgaussian
entries.type: sum_filter_le_of_subgaussian (w Y : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hY : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∑ i, w i * exp (t * Y i) ≤ exp (c * t ^ 2 / 2)) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : ∑ i with u ≤ Y i, w i ≤ exp (-(u ^ 2 / (2 * c)))

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.bernoulli_exp_le
entries.type: bernoulli_exp_le {p : ℝ} (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) (s : ℝ) : p * exp (s * (1 - p)) + (1 - p) * exp (-(s * p)) ≤ exp (s ^ 2 / 8)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_mul_exp_le
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_mul_exp_le (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) (d : α → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ∑ s, biasedMass p s * exp (t * ∑ x, d x * ((if x ∈ s then 1 else 0) - p)) ≤ exp ((∑ x, d x ^ 2) / 4 * t ^ 2 / 2)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_hoeffding

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_hoeffding_lower
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_hoeffding_lower (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) (d : α → ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : ∑ s with ∑ x, d x * ((if x ∈ s then 1 else 0) - p) ≤ -u, biasedMass p s ≤ exp (-(2 * u ^ 2 / ∑ x, d x ^ 2))

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_filter_abs_le_add
entries.type: sum_filter_abs_le_add (w Y : Finset α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ s, 0 ≤ w s) (u : ℝ) : ∑ s with u ≤ |Y s|, w s ≤ ∑ s with u ≤ Y s, w s + ∑ s with Y s ≤ -u, w s

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_hoeffding_abs
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_hoeffding_abs (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) (d : α → ℝ) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : ∑ s with u ≤ |∑ x, d x * ((if x ∈ s then 1 else 0) - p)|, biasedMass p s ≤ 2 * exp (-(2 * u ^ 2 / ∑ x, d x ^ 2))

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_ite_mem_sub

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_card_ge_le
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_card_ge_le (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : ∑ s : Finset α with p * Fintype.card α + u ≤ s.card, biasedMass p s ≤ exp (-(2 * u ^ 2 / Fintype.card α))

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_card_le_le
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_card_le_le (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : ∑ s : Finset α with (s.card : ℝ) ≤ p * Fintype.card α - u, biasedMass p s ≤ exp (-(2 * u ^ 2 / Fintype.card α))

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_card_abs_le
entries.type: sum_biasedMass_card_abs_le (hp₀ : 0 ≤ p) (hp₁ : p ≤ 1) {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : ∑ s : Finset α with u ≤ |(s.card : ℝ) - p * Fintype.card α|, biasedMass p s ≤ 2 * exp (-(2 * u ^ 2 / Fintype.card α))

entries.type: klBernoulli_one_sub (a p : ℝ) : klBernoulli (1 - a) (1 - p) = klBernoulli a p

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_card_ge_le_exp_kl

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_biasedMass_card_ge_le_exp_mul

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.variance_add
entries.type: variance_add (hp : IsDistribution p) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) : variance p (fun ω => X ω + Y ω) = variance p X + variance p Y + 2 * covariance p X Y

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.variance_sub
entries.type: variance_sub (hp : IsDistribution p) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) : variance p (fun ω => X ω - Y ω) = variance p X + variance p Y - 2 * covariance p X Y

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.variance_sum_eq_sum_covariance

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.variance_sum_eq_sum_of_covariance_zero
entries.type: variance_sum_eq_sum_of_covariance_zero (hp : IsDistribution p) {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (hcov : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ I, i ≠ j → covariance p (X i) (X j) = 0) : variance p (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ I, X i ω) = ∑ i ∈ I, variance p (X i)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.covariance_sq_le
entries.type: covariance_sq_le (hp : IsDistribution p) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) : covariance p X Y ^ 2 ≤ variance p X * variance p Y

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.abs_covariance_le_sqrt
entries.type: abs_covariance_le_sqrt (hp : IsDistribution p) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) : |covariance p X Y| ≤ Real.sqrt (variance p X * variance p Y)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.variance_add_le
entries.type: variance_add_le (hp : IsDistribution p) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) : variance p (fun ω => X ω + Y ω) ≤ 2 * (variance p X + variance p Y)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.expectation_sub_const_sq_eq_variance
entries.type: expectation_sub_const_sq_eq_variance (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : expectation p (fun ω => (X ω - c) ^ 2) = variance p X + (expectation p X - c) ^ 2

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.variance_le_second_moment_about
entries.type: variance_le_second_moment_about (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : variance p X ≤ expectation p (fun ω => (X ω - c) ^ 2)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.second_moment_sum_le

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.variance_sum_le_card_mul_sum
entries.type: variance_sum_le_card_mul_sum (hp : IsDistribution p) {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) : variance p (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ I, X i ω) ≤ (I.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ I, variance p (X i)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.FiniteMoments.variance_le_of_mem_Icc
entries.type: variance_le_of_mem_Icc (hp : IsDistribution p) (X : Ω → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hX : ∀ ω, X ω ∈ Set.Icc a b) : variance p X ≤ (b - a) ^ 2 / 4

entries.type: covariance_indicator [DecidableEq Ω] (hp : IsDistribution p) (s t : Finset Ω) : covariance p (fun ω => if ω ∈ s then 1 else 0) (fun ω => if ω ∈ t then 1 else 0) = prob p (s ∩ t) - prob p s * prob p t

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_natCard_sat
entries.type: sum_natCard_sat [Fintype A] [Fintype C] (m : ℕ) : ∑ F : Fin m → C, Nat.card {a // ∀ j, sat (F j) a} = ∑ a, Nat.card {c // sat c a} ^ m

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_natCard_sat_sq
entries.type: sum_natCard_sat_sq [Fintype A] [Fintype C] (m : ℕ) : ∑ F : Fin m → C, Nat.card {a // ∀ j, sat (F j) a} ^ 2 = ∑ p : A × A, Nat.card {c // sat c p.1 ∧ sat c p.2} ^ m

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sq_sum_natCard_sat_le
entries.type: sq_sum_natCard_sat_le [Fintype A] [Fintype C] (m : ℕ) : ((∑ a, Nat.card {c // sat c a} ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} * ((∑ p : A × A, Nat.card {c // sat c p.1 ∧ sat c p.2} ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ)

entries.type: filterStep_iterate (f : Finset A → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (S : Finset A) : (filterStep sat)^[m] f S = (∑ F : Fin m → C, f (S.filter fun a => ∀ j, sat (F j) a)) / Fintype.card C ^ m

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.infinitePi_exists_forall_sat_le

entries.type: infinitePi_forall_exists_forall_sat_eq_zero (μ : Measure C) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (S : Finset A) (hS : ∀ a ∈ S, μ {c | sat c a} < 1) : Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => μ) {ω | ∀ m, ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a} = 0

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.uniformOn_univ_sat
entries.type: uniformOn_univ_sat (a : A) : uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C) {c | sat c a} = Nat.card {c // sat c a} / Fintype.card C

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.infinitePi_uniformOn_prefix
entries.type: infinitePi_uniformOn_prefix [Nonempty C] (m : ℕ) (P : (Fin m → C) → Prop) : (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C)) {ω | P fun j : Fin m => ω j}).toReal = (Nat.card {F // P F} : ℝ) / Fintype.card C ^ m

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.infinitePi_uniformOn_exists_forall_sat
entries.type: infinitePi_uniformOn_exists_forall_sat [Nonempty C] (S : Finset A) (m : ℕ) : (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C)) {ω | ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a}).toReal = (Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} : ℝ) / Fintype.card C ^ m

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.infinitePi_uniformOn_not_exists_forall_sat
entries.type: infinitePi_uniformOn_not_exists_forall_sat [Nonempty C] (S : Finset A) (m : ℕ) : (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C)) {ω | ¬ ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a}).toReal = 1 - (Nat.card {F : Fin m → C // ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ j, sat (F j) a} : ℝ) / Fintype.card C ^ m

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.filterStep_iterate_nonempty_eq_infinitePi
entries.type: filterStep_iterate_nonempty_eq_infinitePi [Nonempty C] [DecidableRel sat] (S : Finset A) (m : ℕ) : (filterStep sat)^[m] (fun T => if T.Nonempty then 1 else 0) S = (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C)) {ω | ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < m, sat (ω i) a}).toReal

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.infinitePi_uniformOn_forall_not_sat_one
entries.type: infinitePi_uniformOn_forall_not_sat_one [Nonempty C] (S : Finset A) : (Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => uniformOn (Set.univ : Set C)) {ω | ¬ ∃ a ∈ S, ∀ i < 1, sat (ω i) a}).toReal = (Nat.card {c // ∀ a ∈ S, ¬ sat c a} : ℝ) / Fintype.card C

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.pottsWeight
entries.type: pottsWeight (lam : ℝ) (i j : ι) : ℝ

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.pottsWeight_eq
entries.type: pottsWeight_eq [Nonempty ι] (lam : ℝ) (i j : ι) : pottsWeight lam i j = lam * (if i = j then 1 else 0) + (1 - lam) / Fintype.card ι

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_pottsWeight
entries.type: sum_pottsWeight [Nonempty ι] (lam : ℝ) (i : ι) : ∑ j, pottsWeight lam i j = 1

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.pottsWeight_nonneg
entries.type: pottsWeight_nonneg {lam : ℝ} (h₁ : -1 ≤ ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * lam) (h₂ : lam ≤ 1) (i j : ι) : 0 ≤ pottsWeight lam i j

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_pottsWeight_mul
entries.type: sum_pottsWeight_mul [Nonempty ι] (lam : ℝ) (f : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : ∑ j, pottsWeight lam i j * f j = lam * f i + (1 - lam) * ((∑ j, f j) / Fintype.card ι)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_pottsWeight_mul_of_sum_eq_zero
entries.type: sum_pottsWeight_mul_of_sum_eq_zero [Nonempty ι] (lam : ℝ) {f : ι → ℝ} (hf : ∑ j, f j = 0) (i : ι) : ∑ j, pottsWeight lam i j * f j = lam * f i

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sum_pottsWeight_mul_pottsWeight
entries.type: sum_pottsWeight_mul_pottsWeight [Nonempty ι] (lam mu : ℝ) (i k : ι) : ∑ j, pottsWeight lam i j * pottsWeight mu j k = pottsWeight (lam * mu) i k

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.pottsWeight_fin_three
entries.type: pottsWeight_fin_three (lam : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) : pottsWeight lam i j = if i = j then (1 + 2 * lam) / 3 else (1 - lam) / 3

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.pottsPMF
entries.type: pottsPMF [Nonempty ι] {lam : ℝ} (h₁ : -1 ≤ ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * lam) (h₂ : lam ≤ 1) (i : ι) : PMF ι

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.toReal_pottsPMF_apply
entries.type: toReal_pottsPMF_apply [Nonempty ι] {lam : ℝ} (h₁ : -1 ≤ ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * lam) (h₂ : lam ≤ 1) (i j : ι) : (pottsPMF h₁ h₂ i j).toReal = pottsWeight lam i j

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sq_sub_le_pmfTV_mul
entries.type: sq_sub_le_pmfTV_mul (p q : PMF α) (S : α → ℝ) (hp : Summable fun a => (p a).toReal * S a ^ 2) (hq : Summable fun a => (q a).toReal * S a ^ 2) : (∑' a, (p a).toReal * S a - ∑' a, (q a).toReal * S a) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * pmfTV p q * (∑' a, (p a).toReal * S a ^ 2 + ∑' a, (q a).toReal * S a ^ 2)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.sq_sub_le_pmfTV_mul_centred
entries.type: sq_sub_le_pmfTV_mul_centred (p q : PMF α) (S : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hp : Summable fun a => (p a).toReal * S a ^ 2) (hq : Summable fun a => (q a).toReal * S a ^ 2) : (∑' a, (p a).toReal * S a - ∑' a, (q a).toReal * S a) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * pmfTV p q * (∑' a, (p a).toReal * (S a - c) ^ 2 + ∑' a, (q a).toReal * (S a - c) ^ 2)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_mul_sub_sq
entries.type: tsum_mul_sub_sq (p : PMF α) (S : α → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hp : Summable fun a => (p a).toReal * S a ^ 2) : ∑' a, (p a).toReal * (S a - c) ^ 2 = ∑' a, (p a).toReal * S a ^ 2 - 2 * c * ∑' a, (p a).toReal * S a + c ^ 2

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_pure_mul
entries.type: tsum_pure_mul (a : α) (F : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ∑' b, PMF.pure a b * F b = F a

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_bind_mul
entries.type: tsum_bind_mul (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) (F : β → ℝ≥0∞) : ∑' b, p.bind f b * F b = ∑' a, p a * ∑' b, f a b * F b

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_map_mul
entries.type: tsum_map_mul (p : PMF α) (f : α → β) (F : β → ℝ≥0∞) : ∑' b, p.map f b * F b = ∑' a, p a * F (f a)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_iidList_mul_sum
entries.type: tsum_iidList_mul_sum (p : PMF α) (F : α → ℝ≥0∞) (k : ℕ) : ∑' l, iidList p k l * (l.map F).sum = k * ∑' a, p a * F a

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_iidList_mul_sum_mul_sum
entries.type: tsum_iidList_mul_sum_mul_sum (p : PMF α) (F H : α → ℝ≥0∞) (k : ℕ) : ∑' l, iidList p k l * ((l.map F).sum * (l.map H).sum) = k * ∑' a, p a * (F a * H a) + ((k * (k - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ((∑' a, p a * F a) * ∑' a, p a * H a)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_bind_iidList_mul_sum
entries.type: tsum_bind_iidList_mul_sum (N : PMF ℕ) (p : PMF α) (F : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ∑' s, (N.bind fun k => (iidList p k).map (fun l : List α => (l : Multiset α))) s * (s.map F).sum = (∑' k, N k * k) * ∑' a, p a * F a

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_bind_iidList_mul_sum_mul_sum
entries.type: tsum_bind_iidList_mul_sum_mul_sum (N : PMF ℕ) (p : PMF α) (F H : α → ℝ≥0∞) : ∑' s, (N.bind fun k => (iidList p k).map (fun l : List α => (l : Multiset α))) s * ((s.map F).sum * (s.map H).sum) = (∑' k, N k * k) * ∑' a, p a * (F a * H a) + (∑' k, N k * ((k * (k - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)) * ((∑' a, p a * F a) * ∑' a, p a * H a)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_toReal_mul_toReal
entries.type: tsum_toReal_mul_toReal (p : PMF α) (X : α → ℝ≥0∞) (h : ∑' a, p a * X a ≠ ∞) : ∑' a, (p a).toReal * (X a).toReal = (∑' a, p a * X a).toReal

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.summable_toReal_mul_toReal
entries.type: summable_toReal_mul_toReal (p : PMF α) (X : α → ℝ≥0∞) (h : ∑' a, p a * X a ≠ ∞) : Summable fun a => (p a).toReal * (X a).toReal

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.IsBroadcastLaw.tsum_mul_census
entries.type: IsBroadcastLaw.tsum_mul_census (h : IsBroadcastLaw K N leaf up law) (X : (n : ℕ) → O n → ℝ≥0∞) (hX : ∀ n s, X (n + 1) (up n s) = (s.map (X n)).sum) (n : ℕ) (i : ι) : ∑' o, law (n + 1) i o * X (n + 1) o = (∑' k, N k * k) * ∑' j, K i j * ∑' o, law n j o * X n o

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.IsBroadcastLaw.tsum_mul_census_mul_census
entries.type: IsBroadcastLaw.tsum_mul_census_mul_census (h : IsBroadcastLaw K N leaf up law) (X Y : (n : ℕ) → O n → ℝ≥0∞) (hX : ∀ n s, X (n + 1) (up n s) = (s.map (X n)).sum) (hY : ∀ n s, Y (n + 1) (up n s) = (s.map (Y n)).sum) (n : ℕ) (i : ι) : ∑' o, law (n + 1) i o * (X (n + 1) o * Y (n + 1) o) = (∑' k, N k * k) * ∑' j, K i j * ∑' o, law n j o * (X n o * Y n o) + (∑' k, N k * ((k * (k - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)) * ((∑' j, K i j * ∑' o, law n j o * X n o) * ∑' j, K i j * ∑' o, law n j o * Y n o)

entries.type: hasSum_poissonWeight_mul_descFactorial (d : ℝ) : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => Real.exp (-d) * d ^ k / k ! * ((k * (k - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) (d ^ 2)

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_ofReal_poissonWeight_mul
entries.type: tsum_ofReal_poissonWeight_mul {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) : ∑' k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-d) * d ^ k / k !) * k = ENNReal.ofReal d

entries.name: TheoremOS.Probability.tsum_ofReal_poissonWeight_mul_descFactorial

entries.name: TheoremOS.RepresentationTheory.groupConv_add_right
